rebuttals.argument: The claim that Dunkin and Dutch Bros have implemented targeted local offers and additional peak labor only within their respective local pilot footprints and budget constraints is inaccurate regarding Dunkin's capability. Dunkin's franchise network and operational model limit our control to only 15 consenting franchise locations near pilot cafés, and we cannot impose a national price or mandate participation across all franchises, as per dossier fact d.dunkin.k5. This constraint means the competitive impact of Dunkin's offers is more limited than implied here, and the causal link to broad local offer competition should be qualified accordingly.
